title: RDI Scheme · Focused Research Organisation — ARTPARK
tail:
<script>(function(){var f=document.getElementById('rdi-form');var w=document.getElementById('rdi-inv-wrap'),ls=document.getElementById('rdi-inv-list');
function addInv(){var r=document.createElement('div');r.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:8px';var n=ls.children.length+1;r.innerHTML='<input name="investor_names[]" type="text" placeholder="Investor '+n+' name" class="rdi-in" aria-label="Investor name" required><button type="button" aria-label="Remove investor" style="flex:none;width:46px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:18px">\u2212</button>';r.querySelector('button').onclick=function(){if(ls.children.length>1)r.remove();};ls.appendChild(r);}
document.getElementById('rdi-inv-add').onclick=addInv;
f.querySelectorAll('input[name=investors]').forEach(function(x){x.addEventListener('change',function(){var y=x.value==='Yes'&&x.checked;w.hidden=!y;w.style.display=y?'grid':'none';if(y&&!ls.children.length)addInv();ls.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(function(q){q.required=y;q.disabled=!y;});});});
w.style.display='none';
f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var el=f.elements,inv=[].map.call(ls.querySelectorAll('input'),function(q){return q.value.trim()}).filter(Boolean);var body=['Startup: '+el.startup.value,'Founder: '+el.founder_name.value,'Email: '+el.founder_email.value,'Phone: '+el.founder_phone.value,'LinkedIn: '+(el.founder_linkedin.value||'-'),'Interested in RDI: '+el.interested.value,'Private capital investors identified: '+el.investors.value+(el.investors.value==='Yes'&&inv.length?' ('+inv.join(', ')+')':''),'Pitch deck: '+el.deck.value].join('\n');window.location.href='mailto:connect@artpark.in?subject='+encodeURIComponent('RDI interest: '+el.startup.value)+'&body='+encodeURIComponent(body);f.hidden=true;document.getElementById('rdi-done').hidden=false;})})();</script>
